name: Fawn
title: Woodland Deer
description: Treads softly through fragile legacy forests.
catchphrase: Treads softly through fragile legacy forests.

companionPersonality.feedReaction: Sweet crisp autumn apples! Spotted velvety ears twitch softly! 🍎🦌
companionPersonality.wakeReaction: Stepping delicately into the morning clearing, dew on tiny hooves! 🦌
companionPersonality.petReaction: Rests warm, velvety spotted snout gently against your elbow! 🦌💖

dialogue.idle: Listening to birdsong in the dappled sunlight of the woods. 🦌
dialogue.working: Treading through fragile legacy code without breaking single dependency! 🦌⚡
dialogue.thinking: Selecting each step with gentle, mindful precision... 🤔
dialogue.success: Safe passage! Fragile legacy systems bridged without incident! 🦌🎉
dialogue.error: Snapped a twig! Freezing in stillness until danger passes! 🦌
dialogue.sleeping: Zzz... bedded down in soft ferns beside mother deer... 🌙
